commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone may matter to that. 2. Go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in the Kothringi Greathouse. The marker is on Hums-the-Long-Note. 3. I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note to find the elder, or look around Toklea. I can see no other choice yet. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, what the keystone does, or who Hums-the-Long-Note is. I could ask the Chime-Keepers.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note is the Chime-Keepers elder. She knows the keystone but wants payment first: her familys carved grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east from Mir-Xal quay) and raise the stake from the Drowned Chest. 3. Fight the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen. As a fighter, fighting suits me. 4. I do not know what the keystone is for. I do not know Zul-Etha or Mir-Xal except what she said. I could find out by going there.

answer 1. I killed the crocodile and old bull in Zul-Etha and took the Carved Grave-Stake from the Drowned Chest. Once Hums-the-Long-Note has it, she will tell me about the keystone. 2. Take the stake to Hums-the-Long-Note in Toklea. 3. I can go straight back and hand it over. I see no other choice. 4. I still do not know what the keystone does or what the Eye is. Hums should tell me.

answer 1. Hums kept her word. The keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall north of Gideon. The knights of Gideon guarded the kings road to the Root, and the captain was buried with what marked the way. 2. Report to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. I can go to Helstrom and report. I could go to Eurydike myself, but my journal says to tell Nesh-Deeka. 4. I do not know what the Root is, or what the Eye is and how it ties in. I could ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. Quest done. I paid Hums with her grave-stake and learned the keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon. Nesh-Deeka knew the Unbound are asking Gideons diggers about Eurydike, and told me to hurry. She paid 100 gold. 2. Nothing is assigned now. The obvious next step is Eurydike, north of Gideon, before the Unbound. 3. Go to Eurydike and open the tomb, or ask Nesh-Deeka more. 4. I still do not know what the Eye or the Root is, or how she knows what the Unbound do ("we listen").

answer Notes: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. Hums-the-Long-Note, Chime-Keeper elder at Toklea, told me the Kothringi Keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall a short walk north of Gideon. The knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings road to the Root. I paid her by killing a crocodile and an old bull in drowned Zul-Etha and bringing back her family grave-stake. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 more gold, so I have about 700. She knows the Unbound are asking Gideons diggers about Eurydike and told me to hurry. I still carry the keystone, Pale Harvest Strongbox Key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note and the smuggler key. Next: go to Eurydike and open the tomb before the Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin). Unknown: what the Eye and the Root are, and how Nesh-Deeka knows ("we listen").
